title: Wednesday - Ziyarat of Imam Musa Kazim, Ali Reza, Muhammad Taqi, Ali Naqi (a)
categoryChain: Wednesday - Ziyarat of Imam Musa Kazim, Ali Reza, Muhammad Taqi, Ali Naqi (a)
introduction:
ZIYARAH OF IMAM MUSA AL KAZIM, ALI AL RIDA, MUHAMMAD AL TAQI, ALI AL NAQI (A) ON WEDNESDAY

This day is dedicated to the Imams Musa ibn Ja’far al-Kazim, Ali ibn Musa al-Rida, Muhammad ibn Ali al-Taqi al-Jawad, and Ali ibn Muhammad al-Naqi al-Hadi - peace be upon them all. Their Ziyarah on Wednesdays is as follows:

verses.translation: Peace be upon you [all], O saints of Allah!
Peace be upon you, O arguments of Allah!

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَا نُوْرَ اللّٰهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ الْاَرْضِ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O light of Allah in the darkness of the earth!
Peace be upon you.
Blessings of Allah be upon you

verses.arabic: وَ عَلٰى اٰلِ بَيْتِكُمْ اَلطَّيِّبِيْنَ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
verses.translation: and upon your Household, the pure and immaculate.
May Allah accept my father and mother as ransoms for you!
Indeed, you worshipped Allah sincerely

verses.arabic: وَ جَاهَدْتُمْ فِي اللّٰهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِ
verses.translation: and strove for His sake with due strife
until death came upon you.
So, may Allah curse all your enemies
from the jinn and human beings.

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَا اَبْرَاُ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَ اِلَيْكُمْ مِنْهُمْ
verses.translation: And I release myself before Allah and before you from them (i.e. your enemies).
O my master, O Abu-Ibrahim,
Musa, the son of Ja'far!
O my master, O Abu’l-Hasan,
'AIT, the son of Musa!
O my master, O Abu-Ja'far,
Muhammad, the son of 'Ali!
O my master, O Abu’l-Hasan,
Ali, the son of Muhammad!
I am your servant,
I believe in your secret and open affairs,
and I am staying with you as your guest, on this day,
which is Wednesday,
and I am in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and neighbor,
[I ask you] by your Household, the pure and immaculate.
